host.conditions: One Godot benchmark at a time. No owned concurrent tests/builds during measured series. Desktop and unrelated applications remain uncontrolled; no CPU pinning or thermal control. Three repeats per build; short deterministic invulnerable fixtures only. Total physical memory unavailable to restricted sysctl; engine static-memory metrics retained.

metric_definitions.error_count: probe invariants; engine script errors must also be checked in the log
metric_definitions.memory: Godot Performance static memory monitors, not process RSS; engine peak spans earlier scenarios too
metric_definitions.simulation_ms: Time.get_ticks_usec around simulate(1/60) only; explicit casting and HUD excluded
metric_definitions.wall_frame_interval_ms: between successive completed frame observations; includes probe/input/HUD, scheduling and rendering when rendered
